checks.text: Chrom + Robin (M): in a combat where Robin (M) doesn’t Dual Strike (or strikes for 0), note whether Robin (M) gains any EXP.
Chrom + Robin (M): if Robin (M)’s Dual Strike lands a kill, note whether Chrom still gains EXP.
Robin backs Chrom: after a Dual Strike of Robin’s that deals damage but doesn’t kill, on a foe of Robin’s level and tier, note Robin’s EXP (5: Veteran counts only leading; 7: it counts paired).
Lissa can Rally: Rally once and note the EXP it gives (0 if no EXP bar appears).
Frederick + Chrom: in a combat where Chrom doesn’t Dual Strike (or strikes for 0), note whether Chrom gains any EXP.
Frederick + Chrom: if Chrom’s Dual Strike lands a kill, note whether Frederick still gains EXP.
